sn46.33:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave, jātarūpassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti, na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
sn46.33:1.3: ayo bhikkhave, jātarūpassa upakkileso, yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
sn46.33:1.7: sajjhu bhikkhave, jātarūpassa upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti, na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca- na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
sn46.33:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave, pañca jātarūpassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ jātarūpaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.
sn46.33:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, pañcime cittassa upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammāsamādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya.
sn46.33:2.3: kāmacchando bhikkhave, cittassa upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammāsamādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya. vyāpādo bhikkhave, cittassa upakkileso -pe- thīnamiddhaṃ bhikkhave, cittassa upekkileso -pe- uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhikkhave, cittassa upakkileso -pe- vicikicchā bhikkhave, cittassa upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā samādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāya.
sn46.33:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave, pañca cittassa upakkilesā, yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhaṃ cittaṃ na ceva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammāsamādhiyati āsavānaṃ khayāyāti.
